description: This file contains utility functions and a main control flow to facilitate running Vitest profiling in different modes. It includes argument parsing, command building, directory resolution, and execution logic for profiling commands, and is designed to be run as a script.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine mode and output directory for profiling.

methods.name: resolveVitestProfileDir
methods.description: Calculates the directory for storing profiling data, either from provided outputDir or as a temporary directory.

methods.name: buildVitestProfileCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command and arguments to run Vitest in profiling mode, differing between 'main' and 'runner' modes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates argument parsing, directory setup, command execution, and error handling.
